audience: web developers and site owners who use bunny.net for CDN, storage, DNS and video

useCases.title: Check CDN traffic and this month's charges
useCases.text: The AI reads bandwidth, requests, cache hit rate and origin response time for the account or one pull zone. It also reads the balance and charges by product.

useCases.title: Review pull zones, storage zones and video libraries
useCases.text: The AI lists pull zones with origin, hostnames and usage, storage zones with size and file count, and Stream video libraries. It opens one for full settings.

useCases.title: Read DNS records or export a zone for backup
useCases.text: The AI lists the records of a DNS zone by type or search term, and exports the zone as a BIND file to review or keep before a change.

useCases.title: See who changed what in your account
useCases.text: The AI reads the audit log for one day with the time, product, resource, action and actor of each change.

useCases.title: Purge cache, add DNS records or block IPs
useCases.text: The AI purges a pull zone's cache or one URL, adds a DNS record, or blocks an IP on a pull zone.
